{{Top}} {{Update|[[Announcement]], [[Rix Road]]}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:Grandi-Andor4.png]] |name=Grandi |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} |gender=[[Gender|Female]] |pronouns=new |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Gray]] |feathers= |eyes= |skin=Light |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Imperial Security Bureau]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|With the next quarter's detention estimates expected to increase across the Ryloth sector, any further erosion in local authority may require an increase in our blackline budget.|Grandi|}} [[ISB Supervisor]] '''Grandi''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who served in the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] with the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]]. In [[5 BBY]], she attended a meeting on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] where she reported that the [[Gaulus sector|Ryloth sector]] detention estimates were expected to increase which might require an increased blackline budget. [[Major]] [[Lio Partagaz|Partagaz]] then claimed she was being intentionally vague about what she would use the new resources for and demanded specifics. ==Biography== {{Quote|And where would you target these new resources, Supervisor Grandi?''"
"''Uh, increased surveillance, sir.''"
"''Looking for what?''"
"''Anti-Imperial activity as always.|Partagaz and Grandi|}} [[File:ISBMeeting-Andor4.png|thumb|right|300px|Supervisor Grandi attended a meeting led by Major Partagaz.]] Grandi was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who served as a [[ISB Supervisor|supervisor]] and held the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]]{{ImperialRanks-PreDS-LA}} in the [[Investigations]] branch''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Security Bureau]]. She oversaw the [[Gaulus sector|Ryloth sector]], and in [[5 BBY]]{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}} attended a meeting in a [[ISB Central Office|bureau building]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] where she reported that the [[sector]]'s detention estimates were expected to increase over the next quarter. When she stated that any further erosion in the local authority in the sector would require an increase in her blackline budget, [[Major]] [[Lio Partagaz|Partagaz]], who was leading the meeting, questioned where these new resources would be targeted. Chuckling, Grandi stated that they would be used for surveillance of anti-Imperial activity, but Partagaz was dissatisfied with her answer and claimed she was being purposefully vague. Grandi denied this, but he demanded that she provide specifics to him by the end of the [[Standard day|day]] before moving on to the next item on the agenda. When Partagaz later questioned the entire room as to what the purpose of the Imperial Security Bureau was, Grandi did not answer. After the Imperial payroll for an entire [[sector]] was [[Aldhani heist|stolen]] from an [[Aldhani dam|Imperial installation]] on the [[planet]] [[Aldhani]], Grandi was called back to the meeting room alongside the other supervisors and numerous other staff. Partagaz told those gathered to inform their staff and families that they would not be coming home and ordered that every [[Star Sector and Planetary Emergency Retaliation plan]] in the building to be ready for presentation by midnight.{{Andor|The Eye}} ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Uh, are you being intentionally vague?''"
"''No, sir.''"
"''I'll expect specifics by the end of the day.|Partagaz and Grandi|}} Grandi chuckled after telling Partagaz that she would use new resources on increased surveillance, but quickly stopped once he reprimanded her. She had light skin and [[Color|gray]] [[hair]]. ==Equipment== Grandi wore a white [[Imperial officer's uniform]] with a [[code cylinder]] on each shoulder and a [[rank insignia plaque]] with three blue squares. ==Behind the scenes== Grandi was portrayed by [[Lucy Russell]] in "[[Aldhani (episode)|Aldhani]]," the fourth episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which aired on [[September 28]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}} Prior to the episode's release, she was visually revealed in the teaser trailer for the show which aired on [[May 26]], 2022.{{SWYouTube|j5UX1Adanis|Andor | Teaser Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/andor-teaser-trailer}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} {{1st}} *{{Andor|The Eye}} *{{Andor|Announcement}} *{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} *{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}} {{Mo}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|j5UX1Adanis|Andor | Teaser Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/andor-teaser-trailer}} {{1stp}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Grandi}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Grandi |es=Grandi |fr=Grandi |ja=グランディ |ka=გრანდი |pl=Grandi }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Security Bureau officers]] [[Category:ISB Board members]]
